A '''[[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple''']]''' stood in the forests of [[Krant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Unlike in other parts of the forest, the ground around the temple wasn't covered with [[Grass/Legends|grass]], and the nearby [[Tree/Legends|trees]] were withered.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns'']], the temple is located far from the main battlefront and is covered by the forest from all sides. It can be reached only if the player destroys a large amount of trees with their artillery. Whether the temple grounds were created as an [[Easter egg (virtual)|Easter egg]] or an intended feature is unknown. The temple is listed as a part of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] faction during the mission.
